meta.title: Nata · Send items with travelers already making the trip

hero.subtitle: Nata connects people who need an item carried to another city with verified travelers who are already flying there. Pay into escrow, track the handover, and the traveler is paid only when your recipient's code proves it arrived.

how.title: One app, three simple roles
how.subtitle: Anyone can browse. Senders and travelers share one account, and recipients don't even need the app.

sender.title: Senders
sender.description: Find a traveler on your route, request a delivery and pay safely into escrow.
features: Search trips by route and arrival date
Price calculated for you from route, weight and size
Money held in escrow until delivery

steps.title: Search for a traveler
steps.text: Pick a departure and destination and the latest date the item should arrive. Filter by the weight you need to send.

steps.title: Check their profile
steps.text: See ratings, completed deliveries, verification, capacity, upcoming trips and reviews from past senders.

steps.title: Send a delivery request
steps.text: Add your items with photos, weight, size and the recipient's name and phone. The estimated price updates as you go.

steps.title: Get an answer within 48 hours
steps.text: When the traveler accepts, the price is fixed in your currency and you have 24 hours to pay.

steps.title: Check the ticket and pay into escrow
steps.text: Review the traveler's flight ticket, then pay by card, Apple Pay or mobile money. Your money is held safely.

steps.title: Chat and arrange pickup
steps.text: Messaging opens after payment. Meet somewhere busy and public, and check the traveler's ID matches the ticket.

steps.title: Confirm and rate
steps.text: Your recipient gives the traveler a 4-digit code at handover. Confirm receipt and leave a review.

traveler.title: Travelers
traveler.description: Post a trip you're taking anyway, carry parcels for people on your route and get paid.
features: Identity verified once with ID and selfie
Choose how much weight and what size you carry
Paid to mobile money or your bank

steps.title: Verify your identity
steps.text: Upload an ID document and a selfie. A face match verifies you in moments.

steps.title: Post your trip
steps.text: Add your route, dates, maximum weight and size, and your flight ticket. Your booking reference is always blurred for senders.

steps.title: Review incoming requests
steps.text: See the sender, the items, their photos and your payout before you decide.

steps.title: Accept or decline
steps.text: Carry up to 3 deliveries per trip, each from a different sender. Accepting fixes the price.

steps.title: Pick up the item
steps.text: Meet the sender in a public place and take a photo of the sealed box.

steps.title: Hand over and enter the code
steps.text: The recipient gives you their 4-digit code. Enter it and the delivery is complete.

steps.title: Get paid
steps.text: Your payout is released straight away to your mobile money wallet or bank account.

recipient.title: Recipients
recipient.description: Receive a parcel with just a phone number: a code by SMS and a private page to follow it.
features: Private link to track the parcel
Chat with the traveler from the browser

steps.title: Get a text
steps.text: Once the sender pays, you receive an SMS with your delivery code and a private link.

steps.title: Follow your parcel
steps.text: The link shows where the parcel is (paid, picked up, on the way, delivered) and who is carrying it.

steps.title: Chat with the traveler
steps.text: Arrange the handover right from the page, in English, French or Spanish.

steps.title: Meet in a public place
steps.text: Always meet somewhere busy, and give the code only once the parcel is in your hands.

why.title: Built for trust on both sides
why.subtitle: Every step is designed so senders know their item is safe and travelers know they will be paid.

escrow.title: Escrow protection
escrow.text: Your payment is held by Nata and only released when the recipient's code is entered at handover.

verified.title: Verified members
verified.text: Posting a trip or sending a request needs a passed ID and selfie check. Browsing stays open to all.

pricing.title: Fair, automatic pricing
pricing.text: Nata calculates the price from route, weight and size. No haggling, always rounded to a whole number.

code.title: Delivery code
code.text: A 4-digit code only the sender and recipient know. Wrong attempts are limited.

chat.title: Private chat
chat.text: Unlocks after payment, only between the sender and traveler, and closes once the item is delivered.

reviews.title: Reviews both ways
reviews.text: Senders rate travelers and travelers rate senders. Reviews are public and can't be edited.

language.title: Your language, your currency
language.text: English, French and Spanish. Prices in USD, EUR, GBP or XOF.

notify.title: Always in the loop
notify.text: Notifications at every step: request accepted, paid, picked up, delivered and paid out.

rules.title: Simple, transparent rules
rules.subtitle: The numbers that shape every delivery on Nata.

items.label: For a traveler to answer a request
For a sender to pay once accepted
To report a problem after delivery

cancel.title: Cancelling
cancel.text: Free while your request is pending. Once accepted or paid, a 10% fee applies until the item is handed to the traveler, and the rest is refunded the way you paid.

payments.title: Pay and get paid your way
payments.subtitle: The right method is chosen for you based on where the sender and traveler live.

card.title: Card & Apple Pay
card.text: Paid securely through Stripe in a payment sheet inside the app. Your card details never reach Nata.

mobile.title: Mobile money
mobile.text: Through pawaPay, with no page to leave: pick your network, enter your number and approve the prompt on your phone with your PIN.

payout.title: Traveler payouts
payout.text: Released as soon as the code is accepted: to mobile money in Africa, or to your bank in the US, UK, EEA, Canada and Switzerland.

safety.title: Safety comes first
safety.subtitle: Clear habits that keep every handover safe.

items.title: Meet in public
items.text: Pickups and handovers always happen somewhere busy: an airport, a station, a café. Never at a private address.

items.title: Check the ticket and ID
items.text: Senders see the traveler's flight ticket before paying, and check their ID matches it in person.

items.title: Private details stay private
items.text: Booking references and barcodes are blurred. Travelers never see the recipient's phone number.

items.title: Report a problem
items.text: If something goes wrong, report it from the app and our support team follows up.

items.a: Nata does, based on the route, weight and size. It's shown as an estimate until the traveler accepts, then fixed in your currency.

items.q: When does the traveler get paid?
items.a: Only when the recipient's correct 4-digit code is entered at handover. Until then, the money stays in escrow.

items.q: Does the recipient need the app?
items.a: No. They receive a code and a private tracking link by SMS. If they already use Nata, the chat appears in their app.
Yes. It's free while the request is pending. After acceptance or payment, a 10% fee applies until the item is picked up.

items.q: Do I need to verify my identity?
items.a: To post a trip or send a request, yes: an ID document and a selfie. You can browse and search without an account.

items.q: What if my item doesn't arrive?
items.a: Senders can report a problem for 3 days after delivery, and travelers from pickup until then. Support follows up on every report.

cta.title: Ready to send or carry?
cta.subtitle: Join travelers and senders already moving parcels between cities with Nata.

footer.description: Send items with verified travelers already making the trip. Safe escrow payments, delivery codes and reviews on both sides.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information Nata collects when you use our app and website, why we collect it, and the choices you have.

sections.title: Information we collect
items: Your phone number, name and profile photo when you create an account.
Your ID document and a selfie when you verify your identity.
Trip details and flight tickets you add as a traveler.
Delivery requests, item photos and the recipient's name and phone number.
Payment and payout information handled by our payment partners.

sections.title: How we use it
items: To match senders with travelers and run each delivery.
To verify identities and keep the community safe.
To process payments, escrow, refunds and payouts.
To send notifications and the recipient's delivery code by SMS.
To provide support and handle reported problems.

sections.title: Sharing
items: Senders see a copy of the traveler's ticket with the booking reference and barcodes blurred.
Travelers never see the recipient's phone number.
Card payments are handled by Stripe and mobile money by pawaPay; your card details never reach Nata.
We never sell your personal data.

sections.title: Your choices
items: You can update your profile and preferences from the app at any time.
You can delete your account from the app once no money or delivery is in progress.
Contact support@nata.com for any privacy question.
